scope: Adapted socket lifecycle, main-thread queue, scene/object inspection and BlenderConnection; other upstream integrations are not bundled.
changes: Removed telemetry, consent prompts, third-party asset services and arbitrary code execution.
Added bounded requests/queue/responses, local connection timeout, token field and socket cleanup.
Added an explicit manually pumped background listener and bounded command draining for Rustmatics's headless host.
Rust commands, settings, MCP tool registration and authentication are implemented outside these files.
